description:
AUDITED at clean origin/main `a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83` (2026-09-03).

## Status

LIVE proportional-compilation question; current behavior is correct.

## Goal

Find the minimal sound activation-key information for a non-recursive body that only transports callable values. Preserve every capture distinction required to ground downstream executable capture lanes, while avoiding specialization caused only by unrelated lambdas having different capture tuples.

## Current mechanism

`World::canonical_activation_key` sends ignored, non-recursive forwarder slots through `Types::erase_transported_closure_identities`. `erase_closure_identity` removes each closure literal's `fn_id` but preserves its capture types. The key therefore shares equal-capture lambdas but forks whenever their capture tuples differ, even when closures come from different construction sites.

The precise caller evidence remains in `ActivationInputs`; this ticket concerns only activation identity.

## Live signal

Independent comparison of pre-split tree 8c3d5ce90 with pinned main:

```text
00275_enum_count_member_reduce   25 -> 26 executables
enum_map_family                 151 -> 152
mailbox_closure_each             29 -> 31
mailbox_closure_reduce           39 -> 41
actor_ring                       22 -> 24
enum_predicate_search           204 -> 206
enum_take_drop_split            196 -> 204
00420_enum_take_drop_split      196 -> 204
```

All eight interpreter runs retained rc=0 and byte-identical stdout.

In `actor_ring`, both `Kernel.spawn/1` and `Kernel.fz_spawn/1` change from one bare-arrow activation to two: `closure[?](pid)` and `closure[?](pid, int)`.

This is eight files/seven programs. Do not use the stale "11 fixtures" title count.

## Constraint

Do not globally reduce captures to arity. The static same-lambda regression `compiler2_a_forwarded_lambdas_capture_layout_is_the_static_key` needs one capture slot at `int` to key apart from one capture slot at `float`; equal arity does not imply interchangeable executable capture lanes.

## Strategy

1. Pin the eight-file cost population and retain existing same-lambda static/dynamic correctness gates.
2. Trace, for each brand-erased forwarder input, where capture information first affects downstream executable specialization, capture-lane representation, or runtime dispatch.
3. Express that dependency as a stable fact/data-model property; do not special-case names, fixtures, or construction ids.
4. Prototype the smallest key projection justified by that dependency and compare it with current capture-tuple keying and pre-split whole-literal erasure.
5. Measure canonical dumps, executable inventories, dispatch plans, analysis claims, and normalized behavior over the full fixture corpus/all doors.
6. If no projection safely recovers sharing, retain current keying and record proof that these activations are irreducible grounding cost. Otherwise land the principled projection and remove superseded comments/pins.

## Acceptance

- The same-lambda int/float static fixture remains correctly key-separated and dispatch-free; its dynamic twin remains correct on interp, JIT, and AOT.
- All eight affected files match their Elixir oracles on all three doors.
- Any recovered sharing lowers executable/activation counts without new runtime dispatch or widened/unsafe capture lanes.
- Full-corpus normalized stdout and exit status have zero unexplained movers.
- Every inventory, dispatch, canonical-dump, or claim-count mover is classified and re-pinned with its cause.
- `.agent/docs/semantic-fixpoint.md` states the resulting keying law and why it is sound.
- Run focused keying/type tests, `cargo fmt --check`, strict clippy, `cargo test --lib`, and the fixture matrix.

comments.text:
POPULATION MEASURED at the fz-kdt.127.2 landing (base 8c3d5ce90 vs head; 597
corpus fixtures x 3 doors, 469 backend dumps; 0 behaviour movers after
normalizing pids/thread ids/ASLR).

58 canon movers, 44 key-TEXT only. Of the 14 whose inventory moves, this
ticket's population -- a forwarder split by capture TUPLE across DIFFERENT
lambdas -- is EIGHT files / seven programs, and every one is the same shape: a
capture-FREE lambda keys apart from a capture-BEARING one, or two lambdas with
different capture arities do.

  00275_enum_count_member_reduce      25 -> 26 execs, dispatch 1 -> 0
    Enumerable.List.reduce/3: main/0#lambda@110-136 (0 captures, erases to the
    bare arrow) vs Enum.reduce/3#lambda@439-517 capturing the user reducer
    -> `(a2_p0, a2_p1) -> a2_r` vs `closure[?]((a2_p0, a2_p1) -> a2_r)`
  enum_map_family                     151 -> 152, dispatch 2 -> 2
    Enum.filter/2: a bare main/0 lambda vs Enum.reject/2#lambda@2097 capturing one
  mailbox_closure_each                29 -> 31, dispatch 0 -> 0
    Kernel.send/2 + fz_send/2: main/0#lambda@1140 (0 captures) vs
    main/0#lambda@1259 (`closure[?](int)`)
  mailbox_closure_reduce              39 -> 41, dispatch 0 -> 0   (same shape)
  actor_ring                          22 -> 24, dispatch 0 -> 0
    Kernel.spawn/1 + fz_spawn/1: main/0#lambda@466 `closure[?](pid)` vs
    relay/2#lambda@323 `closure[?](pid, int)` -- different capture ARITY, so
    provably different lambdas
  enum_predicate_search               204 -> 206, dispatch 3 -> 2
    Enum.reduce_while/3 + Enumerable.List.reduce_while/3 + List.reduce_while/3:
    capture-free Enum.all?/1 and any?/1 wrappers vs capturing all?/2 and any?/2
  enum_take_drop_split (x2 files)     196 -> 204, dispatch 0 -> 2
    the same chain: capture-free take_positive/drop_positive vs take_every/
    drop_every, which close over the step (`closure[?](int)`). THE ONLY
    FIXTURE THAT GAINS DISPATCH NODES, and both are real questions in the
    recursive core -- the accumulator tag `{:cont, _}` vs
    `{:cont | :halt, _}`, and which construction the reducer is.

fz-kdt.127's OWN population (one lambda at two capture types) is six fixtures,
and five of them LOSE a dispatch node: 00277 (180->181, 3->2), a_mixed
(28->29, 1->0), repr_seam_enum_count_after_reduce2 (21->22, 1->0),
callable_union_capture_containment (37->35 execs -- a NET LOSS -- 1->0),
same_lambda_two_capture_types (28->29, 2->0), and the dynamic twin
(26->30, 2->6 by design).

So the corpus-wide dispatch ledger is seven fixtures losing nodes and two
gaining. This ticket's question is therefore narrow and answerable: is capture
ARITY (or 'is there a capture at all') the right forwarder grain for the
capture-free-vs-capturing pairs above? Every one of them splits a forwarder
whose two callers differ only in whether the lambda closed over anything, and
in five of the seven programs the split buys nothing observable (dispatch
unchanged at 0). Re-pinned inventory numbers with cause live in
canon_test.rs::backend_inventory_width_stays_pinned_on_the_target_fixtures and
public_trace_test.rs::ANALYSIS_CLAIM_RATCHET.

title: Brand-erased forwarder keys duplicate activations across seven programs when capture tuples differ; determine the minimal sound capture-sensitive key
